pages.text: It is a Panakeia that has gained sanctity by being imbued with the power of the stars. It can be used to strengthen ultra-rare metals such as neatherite, in addition to being a material for the highest level of alchemy kits.

pages.title: T6 Panakeia Material
pages.text: T6 Panakeia can strengthens these metals into T6 Panakeia ingots.
